title: Image Embedding
description: A vector embedding associated with an image content item.

ts.description: Timestamp indicating when the embedding was generated (e.g., '2024-10-09T09:29:02Z').

embedding.description: Vector representation of the image as a one-dimensional array of numbers.

items.description: One component of the image embedding vector.

size.description: Dimensionality of the embedding vector. This value must equal the number of values in `embedding`.

seconds.description: Elapsed time, in seconds, required to generate the image embedding.

title_year.description: Title-year key associated with this image embedding.
